title: U.S. House · Texas's 19th District
area: West Texas, including Lubbock and Abilene.

context.text: This is an open seat: incumbent Jodey Arrington did not appear on the ballot in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for the redrawn 19th District. Tom Sell won the Republican nomination in a May 26, 2026 primary runoff over Abraham Enriquez after leading a seven-candidate March primary field. Kyle Rable ran unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

candidates.name: Tom Sell
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff over Abraham Enriquez, 64.3% to 35.7%.

summary.text: Tom Sell is the Republican nominee for this open West Texas seat. He is an attorney who previously worked in the office of former U.S. Rep. Larry Combest (R-Texas) and served as deputy staff director for the House Committee on Agriculture.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree and a J.D. from Texas Tech University.
Worked in the office of former U.S. Rep. Larry Combest (R-Texas) and served as deputy staff director for the U.S. House Committee on Agriculture.
Founded a law firm with Combest after leaving Capitol Hill.

candidates.researchNotes: No campaign website content or Candidate Connection survey was located beyond Ballotpedia's biographical entry.

candidates.name: Kyle Rable
candidates.ballotNote: Ran unopposed for the Democratic nomination, winning the March 3, 2026 primary with 100% of the vote.

summary.text: Kyle Rable is the Democratic nominee for this open West Texas seat. He is a U.S. Army Reserve veteran with graduate degrees from the University of Toledo and Bowling Green State University.

background.text: Served in the U.S. Army Reserve.
Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Toledo and a graduate degree from Bowling Green State University.
